message.content:
In French, “Hello” is most commonly translated as **“Bonjour.”**  
- **Bonjour** (pronounced *bon-zhoor*) literally means “good day” and is the standard greeting used from morning until late afternoon.  
- If you want a more informal, casual “hello,” you can say **“Salut.”** (pronounced *sa-lü*), which is equivalent to “hi” or “hey” in English.

So, depending on the level of formality:

| English | French (formal) | French (informal) |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------|
| Hello   | Bonjour         | Salut             |

Feel free to use “Bonjour” in most everyday situations, and “Salut” when speaking with friends or peers.
